The problem concerns an FCC metal with lattice parameter a = 0.404 nm.
Determine the magnitude of the Burgers vector for a perfect dislocation in this crystal.
In an FCC lattice, a perfect dislocation has a Burgers vector of type (a/2)<110>, corresponding to the close-packed direction.
The magnitude of the Burgers vector is b = (a/2) * sqrt(2) = a * sqrt(2) / 2.
Substitute a = 0.404 nm into the formula.
Compute b = (0.404 nm) * sqrt(2) / 2.
Report the final answer with appropriate units and significant figures.
